Name: Starter Slugger
Design brief: Plain warm honey-wood baseball bat with a smooth thick rounded barrel, narrow tapered shaft, short dark navy tape grip and a small rounded knob. Two broad simple wood-grain accents only. No decorations: the default starter everyone receives.

Name: Schoolyard Alloy
Design brief: Brushed pale silver aluminium baseball bat, softly chamfered thick barrel, cobalt-blue rubber grip, navy end cap and one blue collar stripe. Clean economical toy sports equipment.

Name: Varsity Victory
Design brief: Sporty baseball bat with a red barrel, broad ivory diagonal varsity stripe, dark navy collar and ivory-wrapped grip. A tiny simple shield-shaped blue inset on the upper barrel, no letters or numbers.

Name: Street Cone
Design brief: Baseball bat with a long rounded orange barrel interrupted by two thick ivory reflective bands, like traffic-cone-inspired sports equipment. Narrow navy shaft and orange rubber knob. Still clearly a baseball bat, not a complete traffic cone.

Name: Bubblegum Bonker
Design brief: Hot pink glossy baseball bat with a thick rounded candy barrel, two attached small bubblegum globules near the barrel shoulder, lilac spiral-wrapped grip and pale mint collar. Opaque candy material, no detached bubbles.

Name: Mudslinger
Design brief: Olive-green baseball bat with a chunky brown mud-coated rounded upper barrel, three large sculpted attached mud drips, cream small inset panel, navy collar and dark rubber grip. Matches a toy mud blaster palette.

Name: Heat Coil
Design brief: Orange baseball bat with a thick cylindrical barrel surrounded by three broad rigid yellow coil bands, dark navy collar rings, a cream cap on the blunt tip and orange/black rubber grip. Toy heat-tech theme. No flames or glowing particles.

Name: Frostbite
Design brief: Icy cyan baseball bat with a long solid faceted ice-crystal barrel, a rounded blunt faceted top, silver collar and deep blue wrapped grip. Broad white-blue facets, no translucent disappearing parts, no loose snowflakes.

Name: Thunder Circuit
Design brief: Electric cobalt-blue baseball bat with a large raised yellow zigzag lightning inset along its thick barrel, two gold collar rings, navy rubber grip and cyan knob. Mechanical toy-sports construction, no detached electricity.

Name: Pixel Party
Design brief: Arcade-themed baseball bat with a chunky long barrel built from three large stepped rectangular blocks with softened corners, alternating magenta and cyan panels, navy seams and lime-green grip. Must keep the long bat profile, no letters, screens or floating pixels.

Name: Cosmic Orbit
Design brief: Deep violet baseball bat with a thick rounded barrel, pale cyan crescent-shaped inset and tiny simple silver dot inlays, a chunky fixed silver equator ring hugging the barrel, navy handle and purple grip. All parts physically attached, no floating stars or glow clouds.

Name: Royal Champion
Design brief: Prestige baseball bat with a cream-and-gold rounded barrel, bold navy centre band, a compact attached rounded crown-shaped cap with three blunt points, ruby-red inset gem and navy quilted-looking grip using only a few broad bands. No words.

Name: Skatepark Stripe
Design brief: A chunky baseball bat with a long cobalt-blue rounded barrel, wide mint and coral diagonal skatepark stripes, navy protective collar, cream rubber grip and coral knob. Rounded toy sports shape, no letters or skateboard attachments.

Name: Deep Sea
Design brief: A navy and turquoise baseball bat with a thick rounded barrel, three broad raised wave-shaped pale-cyan inlays, a chunky cream collar, teal rubber wrap grip and navy knob. Ocean theme made of simple solid attached shapes, no floating water.

Name: Sunburst
Design brief: A bright cream-and-orange baseball bat with a long rounded barrel, broad golden sun-ray geometric panels around its blunt tip, navy collar rings, deep orange grip and gold knob. Clean premium summer toy design, no text or detached rays.
